# Kalkandere Belediyesi

> Official municipal website for Kalkandere Municipality in Rize, Turkey, providing e-government services, announcements, and administrative information.

Kalkandere Belediyesi serves the local community in Rize with digital municipal services, governance transparency, and public information. The site includes an e-government portal for bill payments and service requests, along with comprehensive documentation of municipal operations, council decisions, and community events.

## Key Topics

- Kalkandere Municipality
- E-government services
- Municipal tenders
- Construction permits
- Urban planning
- Tax administration
- Municipal council
- Public announcements
- Building permits
- Local government
- Rize
- Property services
- Municipal departments
- Community events
- Administrative procedures

## Core Services & Information

- [Kalkandere Belediyesi | Rize](https://kalkandere.bel.tr): Main website of Kalkandere Municipality in Rize
- [Güncel Duyurular](https://kalkandere.bel.tr/duyurular): Current announcements and notices from Kalkandere Municipality
- [Hizmetlerimiz](https://kalkandere.bel.tr/hizmetler): Overview of municipal services including permits and licenses
- [İletişim](https://kalkandere.bel.tr/iletisim): Contact information for Kalkandere Municipality

## E-Government & Online Services

- [KALKANDERE BELEDİYESİ E-BELEDİYE UYGULAMASI](https://online.kalkandere.bel.tr/ebelediye): E-government portal for bill payment and municipal services

## Permits & Administrative Procedures

- [İmar işleri](https://kalkandere.bel.tr/hizmet/imar-isleri): Urban planning and construction permit procedures
- [İnşaat ruhsatı](https://kalkandere.bel.tr/hizmet/insaat-ruhsati): Construction permit application and procedures
- [Yapı kullanım](https://kalkandere.bel.tr/hizmet/yapi-kullanim): Building usage permits and construction regulations
- [Numarataj](https://kalkandere.bel.tr/hizmet/numarataj): Property numbering and building identification service
- [Vergi işlemleri](https://kalkandere.bel.tr/hizmet/vergi-islemleri): Tax transactions and property tax payment procedures

## Governance & Administration

- [Meclis Kararları](https://kalkandere.bel.tr/meclis-kararlari): Municipal council resolutions and governance decisions
- [Faaliyet Raporları](https://kalkandere.bel.tr/faaliyet-raporlari): Activity reports documenting municipal operations and projects
- [Meclis üyeleri](https://kalkandere.bel.tr/profil-kategori/meclis-uyeleri): Profiles of municipal council members
- [Belediye personeli](https://kalkandere.bel.tr/profil-kategori/belediye-personeli): Directory of municipal staff and departments
- [Başkan özgeçmiş](https://kalkandere.bel.tr/icerik/baskan-ozgecmis): Biography of Kalkandere Mayor Mehmet Yılmaz

## Procurement & Tenders

- [Güncel İhaleler](https://kalkandere.bel.tr/ihaleler): Current municipal tenders and procurement announcements

## Community & Events

- [Etkinlikler](https://kalkandere.bel.tr/etkinlikler): Events and activities organized by Kalkandere Municipality

## Optional

- [Foto Galeri](https://kalkandere.bel.tr/foto-galeri): Photo gallery of municipal projects and community events
- [Video Galeri](https://kalkandere.bel.tr/video-galeri): Video archive of municipal events and projects
